notes: The page the hand-eval found keeping three API DOCUMENTATION pages as `api`. Two of them are in `keep` with role `docs` — a researcher does want them, just not as endpoints. The self-link (the page's own address in its side navigation) is in `drop`; so is the Environmental Dataset Gateway, which is a different catalogue and the most tempting wrong answer here. Geography evidence on this page is a download TABLE, which is why P5-62 refuses a table row as a quotation. (P5-62 round two: the page's own address was in `drop` here; the harvester now refuses a self-link outright, so it is no longer a candidate and no longer a distractor.)
